semiconductor_relevance: High — Unitechno Inc. specializes in semiconductor package materials and assembly technologies, making it a relevant player in the semiconductor supply chain.
summary: Unitechno Inc. has been a provider of semiconductor package materials since 1988, focusing on advanced technologies for semiconductor assembly and function test tools. The company is committed to meeting customer demands through continuous R&D and has established a strong reputation among leading semiconductor manufacturers.
capabilities: Function test tools for semiconductor assembly

regional_presence.Japan: The company has its head office in Tokyo and multiple branch offices across the country.
regional_presence.Singapore: Unitechno Singapore (PTE) LTD serves as a key regional presence in Southeast Asia.
regional_presence.Malaysia: Unitechno has a branch office in Malaysia to support local customers.
regional_presence.United States: Unitechno USA INC was incorporated to cater to the North American market.
